author: bardic-inspiration
name: Tether Rope
summary: Binds a creature's movement to a point with a glowing cord.

stats.effect: Choose a creature within range. It makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a glowing cord anchors it to a point within 5 feet of it, and it cannot move farther than 15 feet from that point. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
